name: Park Hyatt Jeddah Marina Club & Spa
positioning: Park Hyatt Jeddah - Marina, Club and Spa: a garden resort on Jeddah's Corniche facing the Red Sea and King Fahad Fountain, with European architecture and Andalusian design
best_for: Travelers who want Red Sea and King Fahad Fountain views in Jeddah
Spa-focused stays, with a separate women's spa and men's spa
Families who want a Friday brunch

facts.text: The hotel sits on Jeddah's Corniche with views of the Red Sea and King Fahad Fountain.
The resort is set amid gardens.
The hotel blends European architecture with Andalusian design by designers Gilles Quiffet and Patrice Hart.
Nafoura specializes in contemporary Mediterranean cuisine.
At Nafoura, dishes come from an open kitchen and charcoal grill, and the outdoor terrace overlooks the Red Sea.
Nafoura hosts a Family Friday Brunch.
The Lounge and Terrace serves light meals and signature beverages with views of the Red Sea and King Fahd Fountain.
The fitness center overlooks the outdoor pool, spa and gardens and has Technogym equipment.
A solar power system in the car park charges the hotel's golf cart fleet.
The hotel is a short drive from historic Al-Balad, Red Sea Mall and King Fahad Fountain.
The hotel hosts weddings indoors or outdoors.

highlights.text: The spa has therapeutic aquamedic hydrotherapy pools.
The spa is split into Evania, a women's spa, and Seba, a men's spa.
Dardasha, the restaurant at the Evania ladies' spa, serves Middle Eastern and international dishes with indoor or alfresco seating.
The Royal Suite has French doors to a balcony overlooking the Red Sea and King Fahd fountain.
Terrace rooms have a private terrace with water views.

considerations.text: King Abdulaziz International Airport is about 30 kilometers away; a taxi takes approximately 35 to 55 minutes.
The spa facilities are separate for women and men: Evania for women and Seba for men.
WhataHotel notes the property is not available for online booking; contact WhataHotel to reserve.
